## Question

One sentence.

## Inputs

Links to the ADRs, docs, and issues that bear on it. Link, do not copy.

## Done when

- [ ] The answer is recorded in an ADR, a doc, or a stack row, and linked here
- [ ] A person accepted it

## Out of scope
